paper_record.title: Evaluating the Structural Basis for Polar Altermagnet Candidate Ca$_{3}$(Ru,Ti)$_{2}$O$_{7}$
paper_record.abstract: The interplay between polar and altermagnetic orders remains largely unexplored in the broader landscape of correlated electron systems. Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ has been proposed by density functional theory (DFT) as a polar altermagnet, reliant on the transformation of experimentally reported $Bb2_{1}m$ phase to a lower symmetry $Pn2_{1}a$ structure. Here, we perform a targeted search for the $Pn2_{1}a$ phase using synchrotron X-ray diffraction on single crystals of Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ and Ca$_{3}$(Ru$_{0.99}$Ti$_{0.01}$)$_{2}$O$_{7}$. No diffraction signature of the $Pn2_{1}a$ structure is detected down to 20 K within experimental limits of $\sim$60-200 fm atomic displacements, significantly smaller than the DFT prediction of $\sim$1 pm. Combined with recent nonlinear transport measurements, our structural study suggests Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ as a unique system where strong electron correlations drive an electronic phase transition without any measurable lattice symmetry change. With Ti substitution exceeding $\sim$3%, a chemically tunable altermagnetic phase with $Bb2_{1}m$ structure emerges. The study highlights the importance of sub-picometer metrology towards de-convolving structural versus electronic origins of altermagnets.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过同步辐射X射线衍射研究，发现Ca3Ru2O7及其Ti掺杂样品中不存在DFT预言的Pn21a结构，表明其对称性破缺主要源于电子系统而非晶格畸变。
one_sentence_summary.en: Synchrotron X-ray diffraction reveals the absence of the DFT-predicted Pn21a structure in Ca3Ru2O7 and its Ti-doped variants, suggesting the symmetry breaking is primarily electronic in origin.

problem.zh: 理论预言Ca3Ru2O7在低温下会发生从Bb21m到Pn21a的结构相变，从而成为极性反铁磁体（altermagnet），但此前实验一直未能观测到该结构相变。
problem.en: DFT predicts a structural phase transition from Bb21m to Pn21a in Ca3Ru2O7, rendering it a polar altermagnet, but this transition has remained elusive in experimental studies.

approach.zh: 利用高通量同步辐射X射线衍射技术，在低温下对Ca3Ru2O7及Ti掺杂样品进行三维倒易空间映射，并结合DFT计算设定结构畸变的实验上限。
approach.en: High-flux synchrotron X-ray diffraction was used to map the 3D reciprocal space of Ca3Ru2O7 and Ti-doped samples at low temperatures, combined with DFT calculations to establish experimental upper bounds on structural distortions.

main_takeaway.zh: Ca3Ru2O7的对称性破缺几乎完全由电子关联驱动，晶格几乎保持不变，这使其成为研究“晶格盲”电子相变的独特平台。
main_takeaway.en: The symmetry breaking in Ca3Ru2O7 is driven almost entirely by electron correlations with negligible lattice response, making it a unique platform for studying 'lattice-blind' electronic phase transitions.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究通过亚皮米精度的结构测量，澄清了该材料中电子与晶格自由度的相互作用，对理解反铁磁体中的对称性破缺机制具有重要意义。
why_it_matters.en: This study clarifies the interplay between electronic and lattice degrees of freedom using sub-picometer structural metrology, providing critical insights into the symmetry-breaking mechanisms in altermagnets.

reason.zh: 通过高精度实验排除了理论预言的结构相变，明确了该体系中电子驱动相变的本质。
reason.en: The study uses high-precision experiments to rule out the theoretically predicted structural transition, clarifying the electron-driven nature of the phase transition.

reason.zh: 该论文涉及凝聚态物理中关于结构与磁性对称性的基础研究，符合PRB的发表范畴。
reason.en: The paper addresses fundamental condensed matter physics regarding structural and magnetic symmetry, fitting the scope of PRB.
